QuestInfo.name: [MONAD: The First Omen] Jellyrash
QuestInfo.0: Beyond the Eyeful's treasure trove is a very different sort of place.
QuestInfo.1:
The place you discovered past the Eyeful's treasure trove is beautiful! The leaves are all frozen and glittering overhead like chandeliers, but you noticed a strange pink object that seemed out of place in the forest.
When Alika approached to investigate, tentacles burst from it, and a rustling at the edges of the clearing started up. It was an ambush!
